about_the_game:
Sokobos 2 is a modern twist on the classic block-pushing formula, inspired by Greek tragedies. You must load all the vases into your cart, but the cart moves too.

Experience small and handcrafted puzzles focused on "aha!" moments with interesting interactions and clever solutions. Some objects can be pushed into water to create a bridge, while others float and drift away with the current.

Designed for both Sokoban newcomers and veterans alike! Sokobos 2 offers a unique twist and smooth learning curve that welcomes newcomers but respects their problem-solving later on.

Set in Ancient Greece. You have upset the Gods, and collecting the vases for eternity is your punishment.

Brief Summary

  • The cart isn't just a container, it's part of the puzzle

  • Beyond vases and the cart, interact with gates, pressure plates, water mechanics, and more

  • Minimalist 1-bit visuals keeping the focus on puzzle solving

  • Teaches new interactions clearly but trusts your problem-solving skills afterward

  • A story inspired by Greek tragedies
